responsibility: Declares the low-level Euler-tour forest API used for dynamic tree maintenance. It defines `et_node` and the exported operations to create and free trees, link a node under a father, split a subtree edge, compute nearest common ancestors, test ancestor relationships, and obtain a tree root, providing the foundational dynamic-tree interface consumed by GCC’s dominance implementation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the low-level Euler-tour forest data structures and operations consumed by dominance code, while et-forest.cc contains the underlying dynamic-tree implementation and tests.
